Description: Boolean value indicating if the D2H FIFO has been stable when streaming from the device. The buffer_stable value is retained between a streaming stop and the next streaming start event and reset on the next streaming start event. The command may return one of the following. 0 if the buffer was ever unstable after a streaming start event. 1 if the buffer has always been stable after it reached a stable state after a streaming start event.

The buffer_stable value is retained between a streaming stop and the next streaming start event and reset on the next streaming start event. The command may return one of the following. 0 if the buffer was ever unstable after a streaming start event. 1 if the buffer has always been stable after it reached a stable state after a streaming start event.
